answer: A stranger cannot walk in and claim a trade he never learned, because the trade keeps its own memory. Ostler stable book with ostlers attestation is that memory, written down and witnessed: seven-year book, 800 horses stabled, hay accounts, monthly returns. Claim a trade on a counterfeit mesa and the claim is thrown out, the claimant pays the examination fee threefold and the ivory is forfeited to the guild, while the mirror is recorded and produced whenever the claim is repeated.
